note: Elf archer, three-quarter view facing left. Green cap, bob hair and pointed ears are head; chin y~428 at centre, hair bob ends y~450 at both sides. The neck, hooded collar, tunic, belt, crossing straps, the dark-green cloak hanging behind both sides and the quiver with arrows/bow tips on the back (reaching up to x~790,y~420) are all torso: a quiver or bow slung on the back is worn, not held, so there is no equipment. Tunic hem y~733 is the hip. Arms: shoulder cap and strap are upper arm; left shoulder ~y465, right ~y457; elbows at the end of the shoulder cap (left y~560, right y~565, about halfway); the mint-green sleeve puff is forearm; the light-green glove/cuff lump is hand (left from y~625, right from y~655). Pants thigh down to the leg strap: knees at the top of the brown leg-wrap bands (left y~810, right y~813), boot shafts below are lower leg; ankles at the instep (left y~866, right y~876).
